00034| /**
00035|  * `serde_json::Value::to_string` of a JSON object built with `json!`.
00036|  *
00037|  * serde_json without `preserve_order` stores objects in a `BTreeMap`, so its
00038|  * text lists keys sorted by byte order at every depth; this prints the same.
00039|  * @param {unknown} value
00040|  * @returns {string}
00041|  */
00042| export function jsonText(value) {
00043|   return JSON.stringify(sortKeys(value));
00044| }
00045| 
00046| function sortKeys(value) {
00047|   if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(sortKeys);
00048|   if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
00049|     const out = {};
00050|     for (const key of Object.keys(value).sort(byteOrder)) out[key] = sortKeys(value[key]);
00051|     return out;
00052|   }
00053|   return value;
00054| }
00055| 
00056| function byteOrder(left, right) {
00057|   const a = Array.from(left, (character) => character.codePointAt(0));
00058|   const b = Array.from(right, (character) => character.codePointAt(0));
00059|   for (let index = 0; index < Math.min(a.length, b.length); index += 1) {
00060|     if (a[index] !== b[index]) return a[index] - b[index];
00061|   }
00062|   return a.length - b.length;
00063| }

00066| export function planOne(tool, args) {
